$comment: Generic meta-system hooks. Merge this into your project's .claude/settings.json. doc_hygiene runs on every .md edit (detects size/format/broken-ref issues; the /index or /reconcile skill corrects). stop_reminder nudges checkpoint+meta-learning when there are uncommitted changes. Both are stdlib: they run with 'python' without a venv. Adjust the paths if you place the hooks elsewhere.
